title: @bsh/degent-x-bot environment
description: Environment variables read by src/config.ts. Safe by default: the review queue is on and nothing posts. Secrets (x-secret) come from the secret store.

REVIEW_QUEUE_ENABLED.description: Only the literal 'false' lets auto-tier drafts post without a human. Review and manual tiers always wait for one.

POSTING_ENABLED.description: Master switch for posting anything (auto or approved). false = drafts only.

X_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: X API v2 user-context OAuth 2.0 token (tweet.write). Required when POSTING_ENABLED=true; absent = dry-run client.

MILESTONE_EVERY.description: Draft a milestone post every N members.
